page.overview:
Who is Cubby?

Cubby is a small bear with large eyes. Cubby has dark brown fur and light brown eyes and belly. He also has a picture of a wedge of cheese on his belly. Cubby doesn't look like most of the party bears. He appears to have a different body, such as his size and design.
